line: Diagnosed with lung cancer, a chemistry teacher cooks meth in an RV with his ex-student Jesse, and gasses Emilio when the deal goes wrong.
Walt and Jesse have to get rid of Emilio's body and decide what to do about Krazy-8, chained up in Jesse's basement.
Walt tries to talk his way out of killing Krazy-8, until a missing shard of plate gives him away. Walt strangles him.
Walt tells the family about his cancer. On his way home he blows up the BMW of a man who stole his parking spot.
Walt turns down Elliott and Gretchen's offer to pay for his treatment, and the family stages an intervention.
Walt shaves his head, names himself Heisenberg and walks into Tuco's office with a bag of fulminated mercury.
To fill Tuco's bigger order, Walt and Jesse steal a barrel of methylamine. Tuco beats one of his own men in front of them.
No-Doze dies of the beating, and Walt and Jesse realise Tuco will kill them next.
Tuco holds Walt and Jesse at his uncle's desert house until Hank tracks them down and kills him in a shootout.
Walt fakes a fugue state to explain his disappearance, while Jesse clears the RV and the evidence away.
Jesse's parents throw him out and he loses everything; he and Walt patch it up and get back to cooking.
Jesse rents a duplex from Jane and builds a dealing crew with Skinny Pete, Combo and Badger. Hank has panic attacks.
Jesse goes to collect from Spooge, whose girlfriend kills him with a stolen ATM. Walt lies to Gretchen about his treatment.
Hank is sent to El Paso and sees a tortoise carrying Tortuga's head explode. Jesse and Jane get together.
Badger is arrested in a sting, and Walt and Jesse hire Saul Goodman, who finds a fall guy to take the charge.
A cook in the desert goes wrong when the RV's battery dies and Walt and Jesse are stranded for days.
Walt's cancer is in remission. At the party he forces tequila on Walt Jr. and picks a fight with Hank.
Combo is shot dealing on rival turf. Saul connects Walt to Gus Fring, and Walt misses Holly's birth to make the delivery.
Walt watches Jane choke on her own vomit and does nothing to save her.
Jane's grieving father, an air traffic controller, causes a mid-air collision over Albuquerque. Skyler leaves Walt.
Skyler asks for a divorce and Walt swears off cooking. Two cartel assassins, the Cousins, cross the border for him.
Walt moves back into the house uninvited and is arrested after a fight with a traffic cop.
Skyler sleeps with her boss Ted. Gus keeps the Cousins away from Walt for now.
Walt makes a pass at the principal and loses his teaching job. Jesse starts cooking and selling on his own.
Walt takes Gus's offer: three million dollars for three months in a hidden superlab.
Hank traces the RV to a junkyard, and Walt has it crushed with Hank outside. Gale becomes Walt's lab assistant.
Hank beats Jesse. The Cousins ambush Hank in a parking lot; he kills one and cripples the other.
Walt waits at the hospital while Gus has the cartel's Juan Bolsa killed and the surviving Cousin finished off.
Skyler invents a gambling story to launder Walt's money, and Jesse works out how to skim from the lab.
Walt spends a whole shift hunting a fly in the lab and almost tells Jesse about Jane.
Skyler offers to launder Walt's money through the car wash. Jesse meets Andrea at his support group.
Walt runs over two of Gus's dealers and shoots one in the head to save Jesse.
To make himself irreplaceable, Walt has Jesse shoot Gale.
Gus slits Victor's throat with a box cutter in front of Walt and Jesse, then goes back to work.
Walt buys a gun to kill Gus. Jesse drowns his guilt in a party that never stops.
Skyler takes charge of buying the car wash, and Hank starts reading Gale's lab notebook.
Hank finds a 'W.W.' in Gale's notebook. Mike takes Jesse out on a run and a robbery attempt.
Walt lets slip that Gale was no genius, and Hank decides the Heisenberg case is still open.
Skyler fears for the family's safety, and Walt answers that he is the one who knocks.
Jesse tells his support group he killed someone. Hank finds Gus's fingerprints at Gale's apartment.
Hank's suspicion lands on Gus. A flashback shows Hector killing Gus's partner Max beside a pool.
Hank plants a tracker on Gus's car. A cartel sniper hits Gus's operation, and Walt and Jesse come to blows.
In Mexico, Gus poisons Don Eladio and the cartel leadership with tequila, while Jesse proves he can cook for them.
Gus fires Walt and threatens his family. Walt finds his escape money gone and laughs in the crawl space.
Brock falls ill and Jesse suspects ricin. Walt's car bomb fails when Gus senses something and walks away.
Walt uses Hector to blow up Gus in a nursing home and frees Jesse from the lab. Then he tells Skyler, 'I won.'
Walt, Jesse and Mike wipe Gus's laptop in an evidence room with a giant magnet in a truck.
Mike joins the new business, and Gus's former partner Lydia tries to get his men killed.
The new crew cooks inside houses tented for fumigation by Vamonos Pest.
On Walt's 51st birthday, Skyler walks into the pool to get her children out of the house.
They rob a freight train of methylamine. Todd shoots a boy who saw them.
Jesse and Mike want to sell out. Walt refuses: he is in the empire business.
Walt shoots Mike by a river after Mike refuses to give up the names of his men.
Walt has Mike's men killed in three prisons within two minutes. Hank finds a book from Gale signed to 'W.W.'
Hank confronts Walt in his garage. Walt tells him to tread lightly.
Walt buries his money in the desert. Skyler takes Walt's side against Hank.
Walt records a fake confession that frames Hank. Jesse realises Walt poisoned Brock.
Jesse tries to burn down the White house, then agrees to help Hank catch Walt.
Hank and Gomez arrest Walt at his buried money, just as Jack's gang drives up.
Jack executes Hank. Walt loses his money and his family, and hands Jesse over to the gang.
Walt hides alone in a New Hampshire cabin. Todd shoots Andrea to keep Jesse cooking.
Walt poisons Lydia, kills Jack's gang, frees Jesse and dies in the meth lab.
